d: A major storm threatens to postpone Lucy’s wedding; Mary and Matt show up just in the nick of time.
Lucy divulges intimate details about her honeymoon to Roxanne; Peter has reservations about his mother’s new boyfriend.
Kevin helps uncover the criminal past of Paris’ new fiancée; Chandler counsels a con-artist (Mayim Bialik guest stars).
Matt and Sarah suspect she may be pregnant; Eric visits Chandler’s father in New York; Lucy’s peculiar classmate falls for Simon.
Lucy fears that she is pregnant; Chandler and his father reconcile; Mary returns to Glenoak to tell Lucy that she got married.
It's the last day of the Camdens' summer vacation. Simon is haunted by memories of a fatal car accident.
Mary returns home with some surprising news for Mary and her parents.
Annie leaves town, Peter defends Ruthie, and Simon plans for the future.
A new neighbor helps several Camdens – and their friends – in distress.

st: Simon's Home Video (a.k.a. The Kid Is Out of the Picture)
d: As part of his college application, Simon creates a video history of the Camden family.
Eric’s sermon on serving others has a ripple effect throughout the family.
To boost turnout for Kevin’s Neighborhood Watch program, Annie ties the event to a block party she’s throwing the next night to welcome Ruthie’s new friend, Jill Dupree, and her parents to the area.
Peter helps reconcile an estranged father and son, while Lucy strikes out on Kevin’s softball team.
When a student disappears, a controversial principal comes under suspicion.
Can Matt make it as a doctor? His first day in the E.R. is grueling: he oversleeps, leaves his medical bag on the subway, and more.

st: When Bad Conversations Happen to Good People
d: Matt drops out, Martin moves in, and Peter wonders “what’s up” with his mother.
Three years after walking out, Peter’s father wants a second chance.
Martin fields a dream job offer and Chandler endures a family nightmare.
